issues.body: The auth_join re-export comment still says the per-path descriptor is "AXIS-2 only; AXIS-1 stays SemiHonest until sq-qhy4". That is false after the containment fix: equality_join_security returns SecurityDescriptor::semi_honest_only(), so neither AXIS-1 nor AXIS-2 is promoted. This public-facing comment recreates the unaudited active-security overclaim that the round-3 finding requested be removed.
issues.fix_hint: Replace the AXIS-2-only wording with an explicit statement that the reported descriptor is the SemiHonestOnly baseline with no axis promoted until sq-qhy4 closes. Keep tamper-evident-with-abort described only as experimentally observed behavior.
issues.title: Public re-export commentary still claims an AXIS-2-only promotion

issues.body: The Mal/HM/N=3 hidden-join row still says "Tier reported AXIS-2-only (see the equality row)". The equality row now correctly says the SemiHonestOnly baseline with no axis promoted, and equality_join_security implements that baseline. The hidden-join row therefore contradicts both the adjacent authoritative row and the code, continuing the same externally unaudited security-tier overclaim from round 3.
issues.fix_hint: Change the row to state that the reported tier is the SemiHonestOnly baseline with no axis promoted while sq-qhy4 is pending; describe abort-on-tamper only as experimental behavior.
issues.title: Hidden-join capability row still reports AXIS-2-only security

verdict.summary: Round 4 fixes most of the round-3 reporting language, including the implementation docs, security descriptor docs, skill, and the equality capability row. However, the two stale AXIS-2-only claims identified in round 3 remain in the public re-export commentary and the hidden-join capability row. Both still contradict equality_join_security, which reports the SemiHonestOnly baseline with no axis promoted while sq-qhy4 is open. The same major honesty issue therefore remains, so progress is stagnant.
